'''Uffel Research and Development''' was a facility in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[X2-4]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Uffel]], which was used by the world's [[Uffel droid community|droid community]] to pioneer the development of new models of [[Droid/Legends|droid]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Thaereian military]] invaded the moon and the threat the military posed to the droids led to the activation of protocols within the programing of some of the Uffel droids that rendered them hostile to organic beings. A number of the affected droids subsequently barricaded themselves inside Uffel Research and Development.
